source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 57
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 57. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.

steps.title: Initiate harvest
steps.body: Press SW3 to activate harvest. Doors must be closed. Digit 1=sequence state; digit 2=outcome (0=in progress, 1=completed, 2=not completed / 70 s timeout).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW3 to activate harvest. Doors must be closed. Digit 1=sequence state; digit 2=outcome (0=in progress, 1=completed, 2=not completed / 70 s timeout).

steps.title: Harvest completed
steps.body: Did harvest complete (digit 2 = 1)? Sequence cannot be exited once initiated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Did harvest complete (digit 2 = 1)? Sequence cannot be exited once initiated.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Harvest not completed — obstruction, motor, or heater issue (E2 path).

steps.title: Harvest failed
steps.oemOutcome: Harvest timed out or did not complete — run test 59 motor and test 58 heater/thermistor.

steps.title: Harvest verified
steps.oemOutcome: Ice maker harvest sequence completed in service test 57.
